Bridgeport Trailhead.directions: End of Bridgeport Road off US 50. Carry boats on the narrow trail that passes under the railroad bridge to the river; launch may be inaccessible at high flows. Not suitable for rafts.

Bridgeport Trailhead.note: Boating access is documented by BLM Dominguez-Escalante NCA Gunnison River overview / float guide: BLM; small craft only (kayaks/canoes) via trail under the railroad bridge; walking over the tracks is illegal (trespass). The coordinate is the agency's trailhead feature, not the launch itself; approximate. Imagery check 2026-10-26: Trailhead parking east of the railroad; consistent with an area point. Stays access-verified.
